question: Who became the new CEO of Cornerstone Advisors in August 2026?

hits.title: Cornerstone Advisors appoints Mazen Ghalayini as Chief Executive Officer and Chairman.
hits.snippet: [hires | 2026-08-04] Cornerstone Advisors, Inc. hired Mazen Ghalayini as Chief Executive Officer and Chairman on Aug 4th '26. SCOTTSDALE, Ariz., August 4, 2026 - Cornerstone Advisors ("Cornerstone"), a leading management and technology consultancy serving banks, credit unions, and fintechs, today announced the appointment of Mazen Ghalayini as Chief Executive Officer and Chairman.
hits.summary: Cornerstone Advisors, Inc. hired Mazen Ghalayini as Chief Executive Officer and Chairman on Aug 4th '26.
